proposals.announcement_evidence: has been awarded a maximum $19,838,000 fixed-price with economic-price-adjustment, indefinite-quantity contract for full-line food distribution
proposals.lexicon_quote: The Subsistence Network (SUBNET)	0603680S	105	Manufacturing Technology Program
proposals.rationale: The only route from this record to SUBNET is a description match on the word 'subsistence' implied by 'full-line food distribution' — the announcement never names SUBNET, the Subsistence Network, or any program at all. Section 3 rejects it twice over: the buy is a commodity food-distribution bridge contract with no named program, and the appropriation is stated as 'fiscal 2022 through 2023 defense working capital funds', i.e. DLA's revolving commodity account, whereas 0603680S is an RDT&E Manufacturing Technology line whose SUBNET project develops subsistence supply-chain technology rather than buying the food. Attaching a working-capital commodity distribution award to an RDT&E ManTech line is exactly the appropriation-mismatch failure mode the rubric names in section 1.

proposals.announcement_evidence: has been awarded a maximum $19,526,167 fixed-price with price-redetermination, indefinite-quantity contract in support of multiple weapon systems programs
proposals.rationale: 'multiple weapon systems programs' is the announcement explicitly declining to name a program, which is the opposite of naming WSS; the phrase overlaps the lexicon name only because 'weapon system' is generic. The award is a Cummins engine-parts indefinite-quantity contract on fiscal 2016 through 2019 defense working capital funds through DLA Land and Maritime, not RDT&E work on the 0603712S logistics technology demonstration line.

proposals.announcement_evidence: indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contract for Army Combat Uniform coats and the Improved Hot Weather Combat Uniform
proposals.lexicon_quote: Military Uniform System Technology (MUST)	0603680S	216	Manufacturing Technology Program
proposals.rationale: The Army Combat Uniform and the Improved Hot Weather Combat Uniform are end items this contract manufactures, not the ManTech project MUST, which the announcement never names; the match would be description-only. Section 3 rejects it because the named thing is the garment the contract supplies rather than the program the PE funds, and the appropriation is fiscal 2019 through 2021 defense working capital funds for clothing production, not RDT&E. The identity evidence is additionally unsafe: the same index carries two different 0603680S rows abbreviated MUST — 'Military Uniform System Technology' (doc 216) and 'Military Unique Sustainment Technology' (doc 105) — so even the acronym would not resolve to one lexicon row. The other twelve clothing and footwear records in this chunk (3, 9, 14, 26, 48, 52, 55, 56, 59, 60, 61, 64, 65, 72, 78) fail for the same reason and are left unproposed.
